paite: Ngai dih ua, huai nite leh huai hun a, Judah leh Jerusalem saltangte ka kaihkhop hun chiang in,
heading: Namte Tung A Pathian Thukhenna
english: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

paite: nam chih ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute Jehoshaphat Phaizang ah ka pisuk ding hi. Huai ah, nam chih lak a athehdalh uh, ka mi, ka goutan Israelte tung a agamtatna uh leh, ka gam akihawmna ziak un, atung uah amaute toh thukhenna ka bawlpih ding;
english: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,

paite: ka mite a ding in ai asan ua, kizuakna man ding in pasal naupang apia ua, uain adawntheihna ding un, aman ding in numei naupang azuak uhi.
english: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.

paite: "Ahi, aw Tura leh Sidon leh Philistia gam tengteng aw, kei a ding in bang na hi ua le? Na thuk ding ua hia? N'on thuk uleh, hattak in, kintak in na thukna uh na lutung mahmah uah ka hon thuk sam ding hi.
english: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.

paite: Ka dangkasik leh adangka-eng na la ua, ka thil hoihtak deihhuaite na tempul sung uah na tawilut uhi;
english: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,

paite: Judah tate leh Jerusalem tate leng agamgi ua kipan gamlapi a na suanmang theihna ding un, Grik tapate kiang ah na zuakta uhi.
english: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.

paite: Ngai dih ua, na zuakna mun ua kipan in tokthou in ka pawtsak ding a, na thukna uh na lutung mahmah uah ka thuk sam ding hi.
english: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;

paite: Judah tate khut ah na tapate uh leh na tanute uh ka zuak ding, amau gamlapi ah Sheba mite kiang ah azuak ding uhi," TOUPA'N achita hi.
english: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for Yahweh has spoken it.”

paite: Namte lak ah hiai puang unla; kidou ding in kisa unla; mihat mahmahte tokthou un; kidoumi tengtengte hong nai uhenla, hong paitou uhen.
english: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.

paite: Na leilehna mukzumte uh namsau ding in sek unla, teipi ding in na theikung kuaika temtate uh sek un; mihat lou in leng ka hat chi hen.
english: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’

paite: Akim a nam tengteng aw, kin unla, hong pai unla kikaikhawm un; Aw TOUPA, huai ah na mihat mahmahte paisuksak in.
english: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, Yahweh.

paite: Namte kitokthou uhenla Jehoshaphat Phaizang ah hong paitou uhen; huai ah akim a nam tengteng tung a vaihawm ding in ka tu ding hi.
english: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

paite: Na kawite uh suah un, buhlak ahun hi; hong pai unla, childen un; grep sukna khuk adim a, bel adimlet a; akhelhna uh athupi hi.
english: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”

paite: Mipi tampite, thukhenna phaizang a mipi tampite! Thupukna Phaizang ah, TOUPA ni anaita hi!
english: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of Yahweh is near in the valley of decision.

paite: Ni leh kha hihmial in om ding ua, aksite'n avakna uh asel ding uh.
english: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

paite: TOUPA Zion tang a kipan in ahumham ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in a-aw asuah ding; leitung leh vante aling ding ua; himahleh TOUPA zaw amite a ding in kihumbitna leh Israel suante a ding in insang ahi ding hi.
heading: Pathian In Amite Avualzawl Ding
english: Yahweh will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but Yahweh will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh ka tang siangthou Zion a teng ka hi chih na thei ding uh; huchi in Jerusalem asiangthou ding a, mikhual kuamah apaisuak nawn kei ding.
english: “So you will know that I am Yahweh, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, tang sangte'n uain khum akaisak ding ua, nawitui in mualte aluang ding a; TOUPA' inn a kipan in tuikhuk ahong kikhohkhe ding a, Shittim lui phaizang anomsak ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters; and a fountain will flow out from Yahweh’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.

paite: Judah tate tung ah engbawltak a agam ua sisan asuah ziak un, Aigupta asegawp ding a, Edom gam gamdai gamkeu asuak ding hi.
english: Egypt will be a desolation and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

paite: Judah gam tangtawn in luah in a-om gige ding a, Jerusalem khua suan a kipan suan zel tan in luah in a-om ding.
english: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

paite: Huan asisan suahna uh ka sawpsiang louh ka sawpsiang ding a, Zion ah TOUPA ateng gige hi.
english: I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed, for Yahweh dwells in Zion.”
